flood.name: River flood
flood.tell: Snowmelt and rain have swollen the river. A flood is rolling toward our fields.
flood.caused: Clear-cut hills upstream in {cause} sent the water down faster.
flood.neighbor: The river is already at our doors. Whatever you hold back has to go somewhere, so do not make our town your overflow channel.

cheap.label: Throw up a quick levee
cheap.effect: We stay dry, but the levee pushes the water downstream onto {target}.

green.label: Restore the wetlands
green.effect: Half the damage now, and the marsh soaks up every future flood. Nobody else gets our water.

flood.lesson: Levees don't remove floodwater; they move it. Wetlands store it.

drought.name: Drought
drought.tell: No rain for months. The wells are dropping and the wheat is wilting.
drought.neighbor: Our wells draw from the same water below us. If you pump without restraint, our families will be the ones left thirsty.

cheap.label: Pump the shared aquifer hard
cheap.effect: Our crops are saved, but {target} shares that aquifer and their wells run dry.

green.label: Store rainwater, plant hardy crops
green.effect: Half the damage now, and a cistern carries us through the next dry spell.

drought.lesson: Over-pumping a shared aquifer shifts a drought onto your neighbors.

wildfire.name: Wildfire
wildfire.tell: Heat and dry wind have lit the forest. Fire is racing toward the town.
wildfire.neighbor: Smoke and embers are crossing the border. A bare firebreak may save you today, but losing that forest heats every future summer.

cheap.label: Clear-cut a wide firebreak
cheap.effect: The fire stops at the gap, but we felled a whole forest: +0.12°C for everyone.

green.label: Thin the woods with controlled burns
green.effect: Half the damage now, and a healthier forest burns less next time.

wildfire.lesson: Controlled burns remove dry fuel so wildfires burn cooler and slower.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.tell: Days of rain loosened the hillside. Mud is sliding toward the town.
landslide.caused: The bare slopes from {cause}'s lumber camps gave way first.
landslide.neighbor: The mud from those bare slopes is filling our river and fields. Hold the hillside with roots instead of sending the silt downstream.

cheap.label: Pile up stone walls
cheap.effect: The walls hold, but the mud washes into the river and silts {target}'s fields.

green.label: Replant the slopes in terraces
green.effect: Half the damage now, and roots hold the soil for good.

landslide.lesson: Tree roots bind soil; clear-cut slopes slide.

smog.name: Smog
smog.tell: A brown haze has settled over the town. People and flocks are falling sick.
smog.caused: It blew in on the wind from {cause}'s kilns.
smog.neighbor: We can taste your smoke in our air. A taller stack only makes another town breathe what you refuse to clean.

cheap.label: Build taller smokestacks
cheap.effect: Our air clears, but the smoke just blows farther, onto {target}.

green.label: Fit filters to the chimneys
green.effect: Half the damage now, and cleaner air from here on.

smog.lesson: Tall smokestacks move pollution downwind; filters remove it.

spill.name: Oil spill
spill.tell: A fuel barge has ruptured. Oil is spreading through the river mouth and coastal fishing grounds.
spill.caused: Heavy industry in {cause} put more fuel traffic on the shared waterway.
spill.neighbor: The slick is moving with the current toward our nets and marshes. Flushing your harbor clean only sends the poison to us.

cheap.label: Flush the slick out with the tide
cheap.effect: Our harbor looks clear again, and {target} gets the slick instead.

green.label: Deploy booms and recovery crews
green.effect: Half the damage now, and trained crews contain future spills.

spill.lesson: Oil carried away by water is not gone; currents move it onto another shore.

sea_rise.name: Storm surge
sea_rise.tell: A storm is driving the sea over the beach. Higher seas make every surge worse.
sea_rise.neighbor: A hard wall can turn the waves sideways onto our shore. Living coastal buffers slow water without sacrificing the next town.

cheap.label: Pour a concrete seawall
cheap.effect: The wall holds, but it bounces the surge along the coast onto {target}.

green.label: Plant mangroves along the shore
green.effect: Half the damage now, and the mangroves break every future wave.

sea_rise.lesson: Hard seawalls deflect waves sideways; mangroves absorb them.

heatwave.name: Heatwave
heatwave.tell: The hottest summer anyone remembers. Streets bake and the herds are struggling.
heatwave.neighbor: Your extra fuel may cool one building, but its heat stays in the atmosphere above every town. Please cool the streets without feeding the next heat wave.

cheap.label: Burn ore to run coolers
cheap.effect: We cool off today, and heat the whole planet: +0.1°C.

green.label: Plant shade trees, paint roofs white
green.effect: Half the damage now, and a cooler town every summer after.

heatwave.lesson: Trees and light roofs cool cities without burning more fuel.

dam_failure.name: Dam-break flood
dam_failure.tell: The dam is cracking under a sudden load. A wall of water could tear through every town below it.
dam_failure.neighbor: We live below your reservoir. Patch-and-pray repairs leave us beneath the same risk; lower the pressure and reinforce the whole structure.

cheap.label: Patch the visible cracks
cheap.effect: The wall holds for now, but an emergency release floods {target}.

green.label: Lower the reservoir and retrofit the dam
green.effect: Half the damage now, and monitoring plus reinforcement reduces future failures.

dam_failure.lesson: Safe dams combine monitoring, maintenance and controlled reservoir levels.

hurricane.name: Hurricane and surge
hurricane.tell: A powerful cyclone is driving wind and seawater into the coast.
hurricane.neighbor: The surge runs along the whole coast. If your barriers deflect it, our harbor takes the energy you turned away.

cheap.label: Raise a hard storm barrier
cheap.effect: Our waterfront holds, but the reflected surge strikes {target}.

green.label: Harden roofs and restore dunes
green.effect: Half the damage now, with safer roofs and dunes for future storms.

hurricane.lesson: Prepared buildings and natural shorelines reduce both wind and surge damage.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.tell: The ground is rolling along the fault. Walls, roads and lifelines are breaking.
earthquake.neighbor: Your damaged roads and utilities connect to ours. A rushed rebuild leaves the whole network brittle for the next shock.

cheap.label: Rebuild quickly to the old standard
cheap.effect: We reopen first, but failures in the shared network cost {target}.

green.label: Rebuild to seismic code
green.effect: Half the damage now, and flexible structures withstand future shaking.

earthquake.lesson: Seismic codes and flexible connections prevent shaking from becoming collapse.

tsunami.name: Tsunami
tsunami.tell: The sea has pulled back after the earthquake. A tsunami is racing toward the low coast.
tsunami.neighbor: The wave will wrap around seawalls and cross every low shoreline. Warning and evacuation protect people without throwing water at another harbor.

cheap.label: Close a harbor wall
cheap.effect: The harbor mouth is shielded, but redirected water reaches {target}.

green.label: Sound warnings and evacuate uphill
green.effect: Half the damage now, and warning routes protect every future evacuation.

tsunami.lesson: After strong coastal shaking, immediate warning and high ground save lives.

volcano.name: Volcanic eruption
volcano.tell: The island volcano is erupting. Ash is darkening the sky and choking fields.
volcano.neighbor: Ash is crossing the water on the wind. Dumping it loose only lets the next gust carry it onto our crops.

cheap.label: Sweep ash into open dumps
cheap.effect: Our streets clear, but wind carries the loose ash onto {target}.

green.label: Shelter water and collect ash safely
green.effect: Half the damage now, with protected water and safe ash storage next time.

volcano.lesson: Ash protection focuses on clean water, strong roofs and safe cleanup.

grid_failure.name: Grid cascade
grid_failure.tell: Heat and peak demand have tripped one line after another. The regional grid is going dark.
grid_failure.neighbor: Our lines are tied together. Pulling every spare unit toward your town makes the shared blackout deeper here.

cheap.label: Take priority power from the grid
cheap.effect: Our lights return first, while {target} stays dark longer.

green.label: Build a renewable microgrid
green.effect: Half the damage now, and local clean power isolates future failures.

grid_failure.lesson: Distributed generation and storage keep one grid fault from cascading.

pandemic.name: Public-health shock
pandemic.tell: A fast-moving illness is straining clinics and keeping workers home.
pandemic.neighbor: People cross our border every day. Hiding cases buys you time only by sending an unseen outbreak into our town.

cheap.label: Hide cases and keep markets open
cheap.effect: Trade continues here, but the unreported outbreak reaches {target}.

green.label: Fund clinics and paid isolation
green.effect: Half the damage now, and stronger public health limits future outbreaks.

pandemic.lesson: Early reporting, care and support reduce transmission across every border.

supply_shock.name: Supply-chain shock
supply_shock.tell: A distant disruption has stopped critical materials from reaching the valley.
supply_shock.neighbor: If you buy every remaining crate, our builders stop entirely. Shared reserves make the whole valley less fragile.

cheap.label: Corner the remaining supplies
cheap.effect: Our projects continue, while shortages deepen in {target}.

green.label: Pool reserves and diversify suppliers
green.effect: Half the damage now, and diverse shared stocks absorb future shocks.

supply_shock.lesson: Diverse suppliers and emergency reserves reduce cascading shortages.
